intent: Start the Ubuntu-deployed shared brain without replacing any agent inference or OAuth route.
preconditions: Docker Engine and Docker Compose v2 are installed
An operator-owned .env file supplies image tags and runtime endpoints
No credential values are committed to the repository
preservation_rules: Keep the existing model/provider/OAuth settings for each CLI
Add the shared-brain MCP registration as an additional tool provider
Use dry-run inventory/import unless --apply is explicitly supplied
